note: Mean is the 1-5 grade; the percentage is the share of checklist items graded a full pass. Each model's images were graded by six reviewers (one per set) working from the same instructions, without seeing the other models' images. Grader-to-grader variation was not measured, so read small gaps with caution.
footer: Rendered on Beast (RTX 5080 16 GB) with ComfyUI v0.41.0-18 (6607f36b), torch 2.12.1+cu130. Seeds are CRC32 of the prompt id, identical across the three models. Full-size images are JPEG q95 of the original PNG renders; the PNGs are in the repo's releases. Prompts, render logs, grades and runners: github.com/jo-nike/moss-kromoss-eval.

prompts.prompt: A photograph of the interior of a vast gothic cathedral taken from the center of the nave, looking straight down its length toward the altar in strict one-point perspective. The camera is at eye level, and the lens is wide enough to take in the full height of the space, which dominates the tall vertical frame. Two rows of clustered stone columns march away on the left and right, each a bundle of slender shafts that rise without a break into pointed arches. Above them, the ribs of the vaulted ceiling cross in a repeating pattern of diamonds and stars that converges toward a vanishing point above the altar. The stone is pale honey-colored limestone, darkened with age in the corners and around the column bases. Between the arches, a triforium gallery of small pointed openings runs along each side, and above it tall clerestory windows let in light. At the far end, behind the altar, an enormous rose window with intricate stone tracery glows in deep blue, ruby red and gold. Where the beams land, pools of colored light lie on the grey flagstones in the center of the frame: patches of red, blue and amber. Rows of dark wooden pews fill both sides of the nave in the lower half, leaving a central aisle open. Halfway down the aisle, a single person in a dark coat stands looking up, small against the columns, which gives the space its scale. Near the altar on the right, rows of lit candles flicker on a wrought-iron stand. A large brass chandelier hangs from a long chain in the upper middle distance. The exposure is balanced so that the stained glass holds its color without blowing out, while the shadows under the arches stay rich and readable. Warm stone tones contrast with the jewel colors of the glass. The mood is hushed and reverent, and the image is sharp from the nearest pew to the far tracery.

prompts.prompt: A hard science fiction film still showing a huge orbital shipyard above a gas giant, framed as an ultra-wide establishing shot. The gas giant fills the lower half and right side of the frame, its surface a banded swirl of cream, ochre and rust-brown storms, with a large oval storm the color of dried blood near the right edge. Its limb curves across the frame from lower left to upper right, and a thin pale ring system cuts across the black sky above it at a shallow angle, casting a narrow shadow line across the cloud bands below. The station sits left of center, closer to the camera. Its core is a long central spine, a lattice of grey trusses several kilometres long, with two counter-rotating habitat wheels mounted on it, one near each end; each wheel has six spokes and windows glowing warm white along its rim. Along the middle of the spine, an open scaffold dry dock holds a half-built warship: its front half has finished angular dark-grey armor plates, while its back half is still a bare skeleton of ribs, with blue-white welding sparks flashing at several points and tiny worker pods drifting around it. Large solar arrays fan out from the far end of the spine in four rectangular gold-glinting wings. In the foreground at lower left, a small boxy shuttle with orange running lights approaches a docking port on the nearer habitat wheel; above the port, large white block letters on a red band read "DOCK 3". Behind the station, a long silver freighter departs toward the upper right, its engine trail a faint blue line. The light comes from a small distant sun just out of frame at upper left, producing hard, unfiltered shadows with no atmospheric softening: sunlit surfaces of the station are bright and crisp, while everything in shadow is nearly black, touched only by warm light reflected from the gas giant below. Stars are faint and few because of the exposure. The palette is restrained, black and steel grey with ochre planetlight and small accents of orange and blue. Sharp detail and realistic scale, with the feel of a practical model shot from a late-1970s space film combined with modern rendering.

prompts.prompt:
A still from a 3D animated family film with stylised, appealing character design: oversized expressive eyes, soft rounded forms, subsurface scattering on skin, richly textured physically based materials, warm global illumination and a shallow cinematic depth of field.

The setting is a sprawling junkyard at dusk. Mountains of rusted car parts, old televisions, bicycle wheels and tangled cables rise on both sides of the frame, forming a natural valley that leads the eye toward a glowing orange sunset on the horizon. Strings of mismatched fairy lights, some blue and some warm yellow, are draped overhead between two leaning poles.

In the centre foreground sits an elderly, boxy robot about twice the height of a child. Its body is a dented olive-green metal cabinet with a round porthole window in its chest, through which a tiny potted seedling glows faintly. Its head is a repurposed vintage television set whose screen shows two simple pixel-dot eyes above a gentle curved smile. One arm is a mismatched yellow crane claw; the other is a delicate three-fingered hand. Patches of rust, bolted repair plates and peeling stickers cover its surface.

Kneeling on the left beside the robot is a girl of about eight with dark brown skin and a big puff of curly hair held back by a pair of goggles. She wears oversized orange overalls and has a grease smudge on one cheek. prompts.prompt:
A photograph taken in a ripe wheat field in late summer, about ten minutes before sunset, with the sun low in the sky directly behind the subjects and just above the horizon in the right third of the frame. In the middle ground, slightly left of centre, a girl of about ten with long, loose strawberry-blonde hair runs toward the camera through the waist-high wheat, her arms spread out to her sides and her fingertips brushing the tops of the stalks. She wears a pale cotton dress printed with small blue flowers, and her mouth is open in a laugh. A few steps behind her and to her right, a shaggy black-and-white border collie bounds through the wheat with its ears flying.

The lighting is golden hour backlight. Because the sun sits behind the girl and the dog, their faces and the fronts of their bodies are in soft, open shade, lit only by warm light bouncing off the field, while every edge facing the sun glows. Her hair becomes a halo of orange-gold strands, individual flyaway hairs lit up against the sky. The dog's fur is outlined by a bright rim. The bristly awns of the wheat ears are translucent and glowing, forming a field of tiny golden lines. Long shadows stretch toward the camera across the wheat, and there is a soft hexagonal lens flare in the upper right with a gentle haze that lifts the blacks around the sun.

The sky shifts from pale yellow near the horizon to a soft apricot and then a faded blue at the top of the frame. A line of dark green oak trees sits on the far horizon at the left, slightly hazy. Shot on a 135mm lens at f/2.8, the background trees and distant wheat are softly blurred, the girl is in sharp focus, and the wheat closest to the lens is a blurred golden wash along the bottom edge of the frame. Colours are warm, honeyed and slightly low in contrast, with the dark green trees providing the only cool tone in the image.

prompts.prompt:
A photograph of a farmhouse kitchen at night during a power cut, lit only by candles. At a heavy oak table in the centre of the frame, an elderly woman with silver hair in a braid sits on the left side, reading aloud from a small hardback book held close to her face. She wears round wire-rimmed glasses and a moss-green knitted cardigan. Opposite her, on the right, a boy of about eight in striped pyjamas rests his chin on his folded arms on the table, listening with wide eyes. Between them stands a single thick ivory pillar candle on a chipped white saucer, its flame tall and steady, with a small pool of melted wax around the wick and one drip running down its side. A second, smaller tea light burns inside a glass jam jar near the right edge of the table.

The candles are the only light sources. The light is a deep warm orange and falls off very fast: the two faces and their hands are lit on the sides turned toward the candle, the opposite sides fall into deep brown shadow, and the walls and ceiling fade into near-black within a metre or so. The undersides of their chins and noses catch light from below, because the flame sits lower than their faces. Each of them casts a large, soft, magnified shadow onto the wall behind. Small highlights glint on the woman's glasses, on a copper saucepan hanging from a hook in the dim background, and on the glass of the jam jar.

On the table are a plate with two half-eaten slices of buttered toast, a ceramic teapot with a blue band, two mugs, and an open box of matches with a spent, blackened match lying beside it. The far corner of the kitchen, with a dark window and the faint outline of a dresser of plates, is barely readable. The image has the look of a fast lens at f/1.8 and a high ISO, with fine, even noise in the shadows and focus falling off softly beyond the table. The colours are almost entirely warm oranges, ambers and browns; there is no blue or white light anywhere in the scene.

The farmhouse has one warm yellow lit window on the ground floor, the only warm colour in the image. A wooden fence runs diagonally from the bottom left toward the barn.

prompts.prompt:
A studio product photograph of a men's automatic diver's wristwatch, shown in a three-quarter view from slightly above, standing upright on its folded bracelet on a slab of dark slate in the centre of the frame. The 40 millimetre steel case has alternating finishes: the top surfaces of the lugs carry fine, straight brushed graining that runs lengthways along each lug, while the bevelled edges of the lugs and the sides of the case are mirror-polished and reflect thin, crisp white highlights. The unidirectional bezel is glossy black ceramic, its engraved minute scale filled with luminous white, with a small luminous pip at twelve o'clock. The screw-down crown at three o'clock is polished, with a finely knurled edge.

The dial is a deep green sunburst, its radial brushing catching the light so that a brighter streak runs from the centre toward the upper right and the lower left, fading almost to black at the edges. prompts.prompt:
A high-speed studio photograph of a ripe red strawberry dropping into a glass of milk, captured at the instant of impact with a flash duration of about 1/20,000 of a second. The glass is a tall, straight-sided clear tumbler filled about two-thirds with whole milk, standing in the lower half of the frame on a glossy white acrylic surface. The strawberry has just broken the surface and is half submerged, tip down, its green leafy calyx still above the milk and tilted slightly to the right.

Rising above the rim of the glass is a crown splash of milk: a thin, white, cup-shaped sheet of liquid flaring out around the strawberry, its rim broken into twelve to fifteen slender points, each tipped with a single round droplet about to detach. Several detached droplets, perfectly spherical, hang frozen in the air above and to the sides of the crown, and a few smaller beads of milk fly out horizontally beyond the edges of the glass. Two streams of milk have already spilled over the rim on the left side and run down the outside of the glass in smooth white rivulets, each catching a highlight along its edge. The milk is opaque and creamy, showing soft gradations of white and cream rather than flat white, and the crown is slightly translucent at its thinnest points, so a faint pink shadow of the strawberry shows through it.

The strawberry itself is wet and glossy, covered in tiny yellow seeds, with small milk droplets clinging to its skin. The lighting comes from two strip softboxes on either side behind the glass, angled toward the camera, which draw clean vertical highlights down both edges of the glass and rim-light the splash so that the crown and droplets have bright edges. A soft fill from the front keeps the milk white and detailed. The background is a seamless gradient from soft pastel pink at the top to white at the bottom. Everything is in sharp focus with no motion blur, and the glass is reflected in the glossy surface below.
